name: @nanobpm/agentic-transcript
description: Transcript store for the Nano agentic protocol (ADR 0056, S6): retention-by-lifecycle over the app DataLayer/SQLite. Ephemeral runs flush the S5 relay ring to a durable, readable transcript on job completion; long-lived streams support resumable reattach from offset. New schema ships as a forward-only, additive migration. Built on @nanobpm/agentic-relay's resume-from-offset semantics.
